_comment: Curated publish titles (YouTube title + thumbnail header) per course, keyed by course id. Search-first: what someone would actually type, never 'Course 4'. One entry per course in src/content/index.ts.
foundations: Databricks Data Engineering Foundations: Lakehouse, Workspaces, Compute and Your First Query
governance: Databricks Unity Catalog Explained: Catalogs, Schemas, Grants, Volumes and Lineage
delta-tables: Delta Lake Tables Explained: Transaction Log, MERGE, Time Travel, VACUUM and Change Data Feed
ingestion: Databricks Data Ingestion Explained: Auto Loader, COPY INTO, Checkpoints and Schema Drift
transformations: Databricks Data Transformations: Joins, Window Deduplication, Quality Rules and Gold Tables
streaming-cdc: Spark Structured Streaming Explained: Watermarks, State, CDC, SCD Type 2 and Replay
pipelines: Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines Explained: Streaming Tables, Materialized Views, Expectations and AUTO CDC
orchestration: Databricks Jobs Explained: Task DAGs, Parameters, Retries, Repair Runs and Run-As Identities
performance: Databricks and Spark Performance: Skew, Joins, Small Files, Z-Order, Liquid Clustering and Cost
operations: Databricks Deployment and Operations: Bundles, CI/CD, Testing, Secrets, Monitoring and Recovery
